USB Communication Time Out
0=Disabled
1…20=Enable communication timeout immediately

USB Communication Response Delay Time
Delay time of the communication response from the servo drive to the controller.

Enable Communication Ports
Byte 0: Port status (0 – disabled; 1 - Enabled)
- Bit 0: EIP Port 1
- Bit 1: EIP Port 2
- Bit 2: USB Port
Byte 1: Configure selection (return 0 if read)
- Bit 6-7: Port Selection (01-Port 1; 10-Port 2; 11–USB port)
- Bit 0: Action (0 – disable; 1 – enable)
1. Write 0xC100 to enable USB port, 0xC000 to disable USB port.
2. Write 0x4100 to enable EIP port1, 0x4000 to disable EIP port1.
3. Write 0x8100 to enable EIP port2, 0x8000 to disable EIP port2.
